pl-l4d25c6-d1e115.summary: Qualifies Alexander's decree that simoniacs be wholly condemned and deposed: unless someone was drawn in by force. Innocent says that those violently ordained by heretics may have some excuse if they leave them at once and renounce their wicked assembly.
claims: Forced ordination may be excused if the ordained leaves the heretics.

pl-l4d25c6.summary: Qualifies Pope Alexander's decree that simoniacs be wholly condemned and deposed: unless someone was drawn in by force; Innocent says those violently ordained by any heretics may have some excuse if they leave them immediately and renounce their assembly.
claims: Those ordained by force may be excused if they leave the heretics at once.
